say:2:1311235001:0.text: Arteka, how is the painting coming along?
say:2:1311235001:0.source_cn: 阿托卡先生，阿托卡先生，冬日祭典的画画得怎么样了？

say:4:1311235003:0.text: Shh, keep it down! Let me see... Oh, it's still not done...
say:4:1311235003:0.source_cn: 嘘，小声点！嗯，让我看看……咳，还没有完成啊……

say:5:1311235004:0.text: Your Highness, I truly apologize. The fact is, I've never participated in the Snowspire Festival, so I don't have a clear idea of it.
say:5:1311235004:0.source_cn: 殿下，真是抱歉。可我从来没参加过冬日祭典，缺少最直观的认知。

say:6:1311235005:0.text: What do you imagine the festival should be like?
say:6:1311235005:0.source_cn: 您想见到的冬日祭典究竟该是什么样子呢？

say:7:1311235006:0.text: *Cough* Please take your time! Rodrigo is planning to take me to the festival secretly, so I can experience it firsthand instead of merely imagining it through a painting.
say:7:1311235006:0.source_cn: 咳咳……你不用着急啦，罗德里戈准备偷偷带我去参加祭典，...

say:8:1311235007:0.text: B-but of course, your painting will still be a treasured artwork. Once you finish, I'll have someone hang it above my bed.
say:8:1311235007:0.source_cn: 当——当然，你的画仍然是宝贵的艺术品，等你画完，我要让...

say:9:1311235008:0.text: *Cough* When I get back, I'll tell you everything I see in detail to help you finish your painting!
say:9:1311235008:0.source_cn: ……咳咳咳咳！等我回来，就把今年祭典里的一切都仔仔细细...

say:11:1311235010:0.text: It's settled then! You can't tell anyone about me going to the festival—not even my father!
say:11:1311235010:0.source_cn: 咳，就这么说定了！你可不准把我去祭典的事情告诉别人。我...
